summary: IT Analyst with 7.9 years of enterprise experience, including 5 years administering Linux (RHEL, Solaris, AIX) and 2.9 years developing Python automation, CLI tools, and CI/CD pipelines. Proven expertise in hybrid infrastructure management, AWS EC2 administration, on-premises to cloud migration, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible) to deliver secure, cost-optimized operations at scale.

bullets: Administer, configure, and maintain RHEL, Solaris, and AIX servers across on-premises and AWS EC2 environments, ensuring availability, performance, and security for 3000+ Unix servers.

Support on-premises to AWS EC2 lift-and-shift migration activities, including system assessment, instance provisioning, AMI creation, cutover planning, and post-migration validation to ensure service continuity.
Manage AWS EC2 infrastructure including right-sizing, EBS volumes, security groups, IAM role integration, and lifecycle management to optimize cloud costs and operational efficiency.
Implement automation and configuration management using Ansible, Terraform, Python, and shell scripting to eliminate configuration drift and automate patch reporting for 1500+ Linux servers.

Execute OS hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation across hybrid environments; automated vulnerability segregation and fstab fixes on thousands of servers to maintain security compliance.
Develop Python CLI tools and API integrations using boto3, Cherwell, and InsightVM to automate infrastructure tasks, backup operations, certificate expiry alerting, and Azure/AWS resource tagging.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, and Docker/Kubernetes for automated code deployment and infrastructure provisioning.
Monitor system health, troubleshoot Level 2/3 incidents, perform root-cause analysis on CPU, memory, disk, and service issues, and maintain SLA compliance during steady-state and migration phases.
Collaborate with monitoring teams to deploy NewRelic on 100+ Linux servers and automate snapshot maintenance, delivering significant annual cost savings and improved uptime.
